messages:
julia.sales: Heads-up: ACME POC ran into a 413 when sending a 7MB context to /v1/chat.generate. Demo scheduled Friday, need a fast unblock. Error: "413 Request Entity Too Large". Anyone have a quick mitigation flow? @omar.engineer @kelly.poc
omar.engineer: 413 usually upstream (gateway/nginx). Two immediate options: 1) gzip request body and use curl --compressed 2) upload big doc to object storage (presigned PUT) and pass a short reference/link in the prompt. Which infra are they on (hosted vs private)?
julia.sales: ACME is on hosted trial but using our edge eu-west region. They're okay with a workaround for the demo.
kelly.poc: Tried gzip and still got 413. Payload was ~7.1MB. I can try presigned flow if we have an example.
omar.engineer: Paste this for presign: ```bash
# client: upload file then reference
aws s3 presign put-object --bucket redwood-poc --key acme/doc1.json --expires-in 300 > presign_url.txt
curl -X PUT "$(cat presign_url.txt)" -T big_context.json -H "Content-Type: application/json"
# then POST to API with { "context_url": "s3://redwood-poc/acme/doc1.json" }
```
ops-bot: Note: presigned uploads will be stored in object store under acct acme-poc. Default retention 30 days unless overridden. Encryption at rest enabled by default.
kelly.poc: Nice. Is presign allowed for demo data? ACME asked about data retention and delete-on-upload option.
ben.security: For enterprise we can set short TTLs and enforce server-side encryption with customer-managed keys (KMS). Presign + short TTL is acceptable under our standard data-handling policy; need signed DPA for long-term retention.
ojmar.engineer: (typo) meant omar.engineer: If presign is not possible, infra can bump client_max_body_size on edge for acme-poc temporarily. @infra-bot can you make a temp change?
infra-bot: action taken: Temporary client_max_body_size increased to 25M for account=acme-poc on edge cluster eu-west-1. Will auto-revert in 6 hours unless extended. Please verify.
kelly.poc: Verified and retested with original JSON (no gzip)  SUCCESS: server accepted request and stream started. Thanks!
julia.sales: Great. Two follow-ups: 1) Can we pitch Dedicated for bigger demos (they asked about cost)? 2) Any quick best-practice notes about truncation vs model max tokens?
omar.engineer: Pricing: short Dedicated demo = prorated minimum; engineering to confirm exact $/day with finance. For model limits: always ensure input_tokens + max_new_tokens <= model_limit. If you expect > model_limit, chunk documents and run sequential summarization/condensation. Example Node chunker: ```js
function chunkText(s, maxChars=25000){
  const out=[];
  for(let i=0;i<s.length;i+=maxChars) out.push(s.slice(i,i+maxChars));
  return out;
}
```
ben.security: Also record that presign flow needs security sign-off for customers requiring strict deletion proof; can provide audit logs on request.
kelly.poc: I'll update the POC runbook with presign sample, gzip note, and link to ops change.
julia.sales: I'll note in the deal: ACME POC unblocked via temp edge bump and presigned upload option; offer Dedicated demo pricing as optional. Closing thread, thanks everyone :rocket:
